title: Bobo language — Grokipedia
text: The nominal system of Southern Bobo Madaré, a Western Mande language, lacks a formal noun class or gender system typical of some Niger-Congo languages, with nouns distinguished primarily through derivational suffixes and number marking rather than prefixes.
